sentences.text: The victim, who has been examined as P.W.-5 has stated that the appellant had committed rape repeatedly and had also made a video of her in naked condition.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the medical evidence with regard to the age of the victim shows that she was between 18-20 years.
The appellant is in incarceration since 14.03.2022.
6. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail.
7. We have perused the evidences available on the record for a prima facie view.
The victim has supported her case Patna High Court CR.
in course of trial
. In her deposition as P.W.-5 she has stated that the appellant had repeatedly committed rape on her and had made her filthy photos and also made that viral on social media.

The doctor (P.W.-3),
who has assessed the age of the victim between 18-20 years but from the evidence, it appears that the medical examination of the victim was conducted on 12.03.2022.
The victim had explained in her evidence that she was earlier threatened by the accused persons.
8. In the kind of evidences available on the record, we find no palpable reason to allow the prayer for suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail.
Prayer is refused.
9. It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only prima-facie and tentative for the purpose of suspension of sentence and bail which would not cause prejudice to the either parties.
10. If the appeal is not listed for hearing within one year from today, the appellant will be at liberty to make an application for early hearing of the appeal.

(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) ( Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
